Bangla.question: ১) ‘অম্বর’ শব্দের সমার্থক শব্দ নয়-
Bangla.exp:
‘অম্বর’ শব্দের সমার্থক শব্দ- গগন, ব্যোম, নভঃ, আকাশ।
‘ভূধর’ শব্দের সমার্থক শব্দ- অচল, অদ্রি, গিরি, পাহাড়, ভূধর, শৈল।
[সূত্রঃ বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ, নবম-দশম শ্রেণি]

Bangla.question: ২) সাহিত্যের কাছে প্রত্যাশা - কার লেখা বই?
Bangla.exp:
যতীন সরকারের প্রথম বই প্রকাশিত হয় ১৯৮৫ সালে, তার পঞ্চাশ বছর বয়সে। প্রথম বইয়ের নাম ‘সাহিত্যের কাছে প্রত্যাশা’। এরপর একে একে প্রকাশিত হয়-অর্ধশতাধিক বই।
এর মধ্যে উল্লেখযোগ্য কয়েকটি হচ্ছে বাংলাদেশের কবিগান, বাঙালির সমাজতান্ত্রিক ঐতিহ্য, সংস্কৃতির সংগ্রাম, মানবমন, মানবধর্ম ও সমাজবিপ্লব, দ্বিজাতিতত্ত্ব, নিয়তিবাদ ও বিজ্ঞান-চেতনা, সংস্কৃতি ও বুদ্ধিজীবী সমাচার, আমাদের চিন্তাচর্চার দিক-দিগন্ত, রাজনীতি ও দুর্নীতি বিষয়ক কথাবার্তা, ধর্মতন্ত্রী মৌলবাদের ভূত ভবিষ্যৎ, পাকিস্তানের ভূত দর্শন, ভাষা সংস্কৃতি উৎস নিয়ে ভাবনা চিন্তা, প্রাকৃতজনের জীবনদর্শন, সত্য যে কঠিন, আমার রবীন্দ্র অবলোকন, কালের কপোল তলে, প্রান্তিক ভাবনা পুঞ্জ, ব্যাকরণের ভয় অকারণ ইত্যাদি।
www.channelionline.com

Bangla.question: ৩) নিচের কোনটি ঘোষ মহাপ্রাণ ধ্বনি?
Bangla.exp:
‘ভ’ ঘোষ মহাপ্রাণ ধ্বনি।
যেসব ধ্বনি উচ্চারণের সময় স্বরতন্ত্রী অনুরণিত হয়, তাদের ঘোষ ধ্বনি এবং যেসব ধ্বনি উচ্চারণের সময় স্বরতন্ত্রী অনুরণিত হয় না তাদের অঘোষ ধ্বনি বলে।
অন্যদিকে যেসব ধ্বনি উচ্চারণের সময় বাতাসের চাপের আধিক্য থাকে, তাদের মহাপ্রাণ ধ্বনি এবং যেসব ধ্বনি উচ্চারণের সময় বাতাসের চাপের আধিক্য থাকে না, তাদের অল্পপ্রাণ ধ্বনি বলে।
শ, ষ, স- এ তিনটি বর্ণে দ্যোতিত ধ্বনি অঘোষ অল্পপ্রাণ, ‘হ’ ঘোষ মহাপ্রাণ।
[সূত্রঃ বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ, নবম-দশম শ্রেণি]

Bangla.question: ৪) ‘Brochure’ শব্দের বাংলা পারিভাষা-
Bangla.exp:
Brochure এর বাংলা পরিভাষা হল- পুস্তিকা।
Deed - দলিল
Debenture - ঋণপত্র
Certificate - প্রশংসাপত্র।
[সূত্রঃ বাংলা ভাষা ও সাহিত্য জিজ্ঞাসা, ড. সৌমিত্র শেখর]

Bangla.question: ৫) বাক্যের অর্থসঙ্গতি রক্ষার জন্য সুশৃঙ্খল পদবিন্যাসই-
Bangla.exp:
একটি সার্থক বাক্যের তিনটি গুণ থাকে- আকাঙ্খা, আসত্তি ও যোগ্যতা।
বাক্যের অর্থ পরিষ্কারভাবে বোঝার জন্য একপদের পর অন্যপদ শোনার যে আগ্রহ জাগে, তাকে বলা হয় আকাঙ্খা।
বাক্যে ব্যবহৃত পদগুলোর মাঝে অর্থের সঙ্গতি বা মিল রাখার জন্য সুশৃঙ্খলভাবে পদবিন্যাসকেই বলা হয় আসত্তি।
মনোভাব প্রকাশের জন্য বাক্যের পদগুলো এমনভাবে সাজাতে হবে যাতে অর্থ প্রকাশে বাধার সৃষ্টি না করে।
বাক্যস্থিত পদসমূহের অর্থগত এবং ভাবগত মিলবন্ধনের নাম যোগ্যতা।
[সূত্রঃ বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ, নবম-দশম শ্রেণি]

Bangla.question: ৬) ‘গ্রাহী’ শব্দের প্রকৃতি ও প্রত্যয় কি হবে?
Bangla.exp:
‘গ্রাহী’ শব্দের প্রকৃতি ও প্রত্যয় √গ্রহ + ণিন।
সূত্র- বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ, নবম-দশম শ্রেণী।

Bangla.question: ৭) অনেক ব্যাকরণবিদ দ্বিগু সমাসকে কোন সমাসের অন্তর্ভুক্ত করেছেন?
Bangla.exp:
দ্বিগু সমাসকে অনেক ব্যাকরণবিদ কর্মধারয় সমাসের অন্তর্ভুক্ত করেছেন।
আবার কেউ কেউ কর্মধারয়কেও তৎপুরুষ সমাসের অন্তর্ভুক্ত বলে মনে করেন।
এদিক থেকে সমাস মূলত চারটি: দ্বন্দ্ব, তৎপুরুষ, বহুব্রীহি, অব্যয়ীভাব।
[সূত্রঃ বাংলা ভাষার ব্যকরণ, নবম-দশম শ্রেণী]

Bangla.question: ৮) বাংলা বর্ণমালায় মাত্রাহীন ব্যঞ্জনবর্ণ কয়টি?
Bangla.exp:
বাংলা বর্ণের উপরের দাগকে মাত্রা বলে।
বাংলা বর্ণমালায় বর্ণের সংখ্যা ৫০টি।
এরমধ্যে মাত্রাহীন ১০টি, অর্ধমাত্রার ৮টি এবং পূর্ণমাত্রার ৩২টি।
মাত্রাহীন ১০ টি বর্ণের মধ্যে ব্যঞ্জনবর্ণ ৬টি এবং স্বরবর্ণ ৪টি।
উৎসঃ শীকর বাংলা প্রশ্ন-পাঠ, মোহসীনা নাজিলা।

Bangla.question: ৯) কোনটি বিশেষ নিয়মে সাধিত স্ত্রী বাচক শব্দ?
Bangla.exp:
কোন কোন পুরুষবাচক শব্দ থেকে বিশেষ নিয়মে স্ত্রীবাচক শব্দ গঠিত হয়।
যেমনঃ রাজা-রানি, সম্রাট-সম্রাজ্ঞী, নর-নারী, যুবক-যুবতী, শ্বশুর-শ্বশ্রু, বন্ধু-বান্ধবী ইত্যাদি।
উৎসঃ বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ, নবম-দশম শ্রেণি।

Bangla.question: ১০) যে তৎপুরুষ সমাসে পূর্বপদের দ্বিতীয়া বিভক্তি লোপ হয় না তাকে বলে -
Bangla.exp:
যে তৎপুরুষ সমাসে পূর্বপদের দ্বিতীয়া বিভক্তি লোপ হয় না, তাকে অলুক তৎপুরুষ সমাস বলে।
যেমনঃ গায়ে পড়া = গায়েপড়া উৎসঃ বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ-নবম দশম শ্রেণী

Bangla.question: ১১) কোন শব্দে অপত্য অর্থে ষ্ণ প্রত্যয় যুক্ত হয়েছে?
১২) কোন শব্দগুচ্ছের সবগুলো বানানই সঠিক?
Bangla.exp:
কতকগুলো শব্দে স্বভাবতই ণ হয়। ক-ভণীতা নয় ভণিতা, খ-নিক্কণ নয় নিক্বণ, গ-চিক্বণ নয় চিক্কণ হবে।
বাংলা একাডেমি অভিধান অনুসারে বিপণি এবং বিপণী দুটি বানানই সঠিক। এদের অর্থ- দোকান, পণ্যশালা, হাট, বাজার।

Antonyms: Continuation, Action, Activity, Operation

তবে এখানে অপশন অনুসারে যেহেতু Domicile - ই সবচেয়ে গ্রহনযোগ্য উত্তর তাই এটা বাতিল করা হবে না।

Determined : having made a firm decision and being resolved not to change it.

Barbarian: an uncultured or brutish person.

Synonyms: Lethargy, Apathy, Dullness, Fatigue

Interpolation: the insertion of something of a different nature into something else.
Appendix: a section or table of subsidiary matter at the end of a book or document

English.exp:

Little : small in size, amount, or degree.

Huge : extremely large; enormous.
Massive : exceptionally large.

Math.question: ১) A tank is filled in 5 hours by three pipes A, B and C. The pipe C is twice as fast as B and B is twice as fast as A. How much time will pipe A alone take to fill the tank?
Math.exp:
Suppose pipe A alone takes x hours to fill the tank.
Then, pipes B and C will take x/2 and x/4 hours respectively to fill the tank.
∴ 1/x + 2/x + 4/x = 1/5 ⇒ 7/x = 1/5
⇒ x = 35 hours

Math.question: ২) The ratio of the amount of work done by (x-1) labours in (x+1) days and (x+1) labours in (x+2) days is 5 : 6. Then the value of x is?
Math.exp:
From M1D1 = M2D2
⇒ M1D1 / M2D2 = 5/6
⇒ (x−1)(x+1)/(x+1)(x+2) = 5/6
⇒ (x−1)/(x+2) = 5/6
⇒ 6x−6 = 5x+10
⇒ x = 16

Math.question: ৩) A and B together can complete a work in 3 days. They started together but after 2 days, B left the work. If the work is completed after two more days, B alone could do the work in-
Math.exp:
(A+B)'s one day's work = 1/3 part
(A+B) works 2 days together = 2/3 part
Remaining work = (1−2)/3 = 1/3 part
1/3 part of work is completed by A in two days
Hence, one day's work of A = 1/6
Then, one day's work of B = 1/3 − 1/6 = 1/6
So, B alone can complete the whole work in 6 days.

Math.question: ৪) A man bought oranges at the rate of 8 for Tk. 34 and sold them at the rate of 12 for Tk. 57. How many oranges should be sold to earn a net profit of Tk. 45?
Math.exp:
CP of 1 orange
= Tk.34/8
= Tk.4.25
SP of 1 orange
=Tk. 57/12
=Tk.4.75
Profit on each apple
= (4.75 - 4.25)
= Tk. 0.50
∴ Number of apples required
= 45/ 0.50 =90

Math.question: ৫) Excluding stoppages, the speed of a bus is 54 kmph and including stoppages, it is 45 kmph. For how many minutes does the bus stop per hour?
Math.exp:
Due to stoppages, it covers 9 km less.
Time taken to cover 9 km = (9/54)×60 = 10 min.

Math.question: ৬) To gain 10% on selling sample of milk at the cost price of pure milk, the quantity of water to be mixed with 50 kg. of pure milk is:
Math.exp:
Let the quantity of water mixed be x kg. L
et CP of 1 kg of pure milk = Tk 1.
Hence, % gain = x × (100/50)
10 = 100x/50
Or, 2x = 10
or, x = 5 kg.

Math.question: ৭) A shopkeeper expects a gain of 22.5% on his cost price. If in a week, his sale was of Tk 392, what was his profit?
৮) Two men start together to walk a certain distance, one at 4 km/hr and another at 3 km/hr. The former arrives half an hour before the latter. Find the distance -
Math.exp:
If the required distance be x km,
then (x/3)−(x/4)= 1/2
⇒ (4x−3x)/12= 1/2
⇒ x/12= 1/2
⇒ x= 6 km

Math.question: ৯) After decreasing 24% in the price of an article costs Tk.912. Find the actual cost of an article?

১০) Car A travels at the speed of 65 km/hr and reaches its destination in 8 hours. Car B travels at the speed of 70 km/hr and reaches its destination in 4 hours. What is the ratio of the distance covered by car A and car B respectively?
Math.exp:
Required ratio:
= (65×8):(70×4)
= 520:280
= 13:7

Math.question: ১১) A person is walking at a speed of 5 km/hr along a railway track. If he is 200 m ahead of the train which is 100 m long and runs at a speed of 60 km/hr in same direction, then what is the time required to pass the person?
Math.exp:
Given: Speed of the person = 5 km/hr,
length of train = 100 m,
speed of train = 60 km/hr
Speed of train relative to walking person = (60–5) = 55 km/hr
Convert km/hr into m/s
55 km/hr = 55 x(5/18) = 15.27 m/s
Distance to be covered by the train = 200 + 100 = 300 m
Therefore, time taken by the train to cross the person = Distance over speed =300/15.27 = 19.64 sec

Math.question: ১২) Two goods train each 500 m long, are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks. Their speeds are 45 km/hr and 30 km/hr respectively. Find the time taken by the slower train to pass the driver of the faster one.
Math.exp:
Relative speed
= (45+30) km/hr
= 75x(5/18) m/sec
= 125/6 m/sec.
We have to find the time taken by the slower train to pass the DRIVER of the faster train and not the complete train.
So, distance covered = Length of the slower train.
Therefore, Distance covered = 500 m.
Required time =500x(6/125) = 24 sec.

Math.question: ১৩) A man's speed with the current is 15 km/hr and the speed of the current is 2.5 km/hr. The man's speed against the current is:
Math.exp:
Man's speed with the current = 15 km/hr
=> speed of the man + speed of the current = 15 km/hr
Speed of the current is 2.5 km/hr
Hence, speed of the man = 15-2.5 = 12.5 km/hr
Man's speed against the current
= speed of the man - speed of the current
= 12.5-2.5 = 10 km/hr

Math.question: ১৪) A and B started a business in partnership investing Tk. 20,000 and Tk. 15,000 respectively. After six months, C joined them with Tk. 20,000. What will be B's share in total profit of Tk. 25,000 earned at the end of 2 years from the starting of the business?
১৫) A started a business with tk 21,000 and is joined afterwards by B with tk 36,000. After how many months did B join if the profits at the end of the year are divided equally?
Math.exp:
Suppose B joined after x months
21000 × 12 = 36000 × (12 - x)
⇒ 36x = 180
⇒ x = 5

Math.question: ১৬) Tk. 120 are divided among A, B, C such that A's share is Tk. 20 more than B's and Tk. 20 less than C's. What is B's share?
Math.exp:
Let C = x. Then A = (x—20) and B = (x—40).
so, x + x - 20 + x - 40 = 120 Or, x=60. s
o, B's share = (60-40)= Tk. 20

Math.question: ১৭) A person lends Tk. 1540 for five year and Tk. 1800 for four year. If he gets Tk. 1788 as interest on both amounts, what is the rate of interest?
Math.exp:
Let the interest rate be r%
We know that, S.I = PTR/100
=> (1540 x 5 x r)/100 + (1800 x 4 x r)/100 = 1788
=> r = 178800/14900 = 12%

Math.question: ১৮) A is two year older than B who is twice as old as C. If the total of the ages of A, B and C be 27, then how old is B?
Math.exp:
Let C's age be x year.
Then, B's age = 2x year.
A's age = (2x + 2) year.
(2x + 2) + 2x + x = 27
5x = 25
=> x = 5
Hence, B's age = 2x = 10 year.

Math.question: ১৯) A number between 1000 and 2000 which when divided by 30, 36 and 80 gives a remainder 11 in each case is = ?
Math.exp:
LCM of 30, 36, 80 = 720
Number = 720 × K + 11 (K = 2)
Then the number = 720 × 2 + 11 = 1440 + 11 = 1451

Math.question: ২০) The difference between two integers is 5. Their product is 500. Find the numbers.
Math.exp:
Let the integers be x and (x + 5)
Then, ⇔x(x+5)=500
⇔x2+5x−500=0
⇔(x+25)(x−20)=0
⇔x=20
So, the numbers are 20 and 25

Math.question: ২৪) In an examination there are three multiple choice questions and each question has 4 choices. The number of ways in which a student can fail to get all answer correct is-
Math.exp:
Number of ways of attempting 1st, 2nd, 3rd question are each.
Total number of ways 43 = 4 × 4 × 4 = 64
Number of ways, getting correct answers = 13 = 1

General Knowledge.question: ১) Strait of Malacca separates ________.
General Knowledge.exp: Strait of Malacca separates Sumatra and Malaysia. The Strait of Malacca (also called the Straits of Malacca, and in Malay Selat Melaka) is a narrow stretch of water between Peninsular Malaysia (West Malaysia) and the Indonesian island of Sumatra.

General Knowledge.question: ২) Who established the famous Buddhist monastery 'Sompur Vihara' at Paharpur in Naogaon district.?
General Knowledge.exp:
The Pala dynasty ruled for the first long four hundred years in the history of Bengal. They were Buddhists. Bengal was ruled by 16 kings of this dynasty. Gopal was the founder of the Pala dynasty. After Gopal's death, his son Dharmapala became the king of Bengal. Dharmapala is the best king of the Pala dynasty. He ruled for about 40 years. During his long reign, Dharmapala raised the Pala kingdom into an empire. That is why he has become famous in the history of ancient Bengal. He took the title of 'Vikramshiladev'. Raja Dharmapala established the famous Buddhist monastery 'Sompur Vihara' at Paharpur in the present Naogaon district of Rajshahi division.
[Source: History and World Civilization of Bangladesh, 9th-10th class and History and World Civilization of Bangladesh, SSC, open]

General Knowledge.question: ৩) The United Front was originally made up of how many political parties?
General Knowledge.exp:
When the elections to the East Bengal Legislative Assembly were announced, the United Front was formed with the aim of defeating the ruling Muslim League. The United Front was originally made up of four political parties - the Awami Muslim League, led by Maulana Abdul Hamid Khan Bhasani, and Sher-e-Bangla A. K. The Krishak Praja Party led by Fazlul Huq, Maulana Atahar Ali's Nezame Islam Party, and Haji Danesh's Left Democratic Party. The electoral symbol of the United Front was the boat. Hossain Shaheed Suhrawardy was the president of the United Front.
[Source: History and World Civilization of Bangladesh: Class IX-X]

General Knowledge.question: ৪) From which financial year value added tax has been introduced?
General Knowledge.exp:
Value Added Tax (VAT) is a percentage tax on value added at the end of each stage of production and distribution of a product or service. Value Added Tax has been introduced in Bangladesh in the financial year 1991-1992. This is the highest revenue of the government of Bangladesh.
[Source: Live MCQ Archive and Economics, 9th-10th grade]

General Knowledge.question: ৫) What was the number of members of the constitution drafting committee?
General Knowledge.exp:
The number of members of the constitution drafting committee of Bangladesh was 34. The only member of the opposition was Suranjit Sengupta. He was a member of the National Awami Party (NAP, Mozaffar) and did not sign the original constitution. Note that the then law minister was the chairman of the constitution drafting committee. Kamal Hossain. The only female member was Begum Razia Banu.
Source: Constitution of Bangladesh: Arif Khan

General Knowledge.question: ৬) How many schedules are there in the constitution of Bangladesh?
General Knowledge.exp:
There are a total of 7 schedules in the constitution of Bangladesh.
First Schedule - Law applicable in spite of other provisions.
Second Schedule - Presidential Elections Abolished
Third Schedule - Oath and Declaration.
Fourth Schedule - Tactical and Temporary Provisions.
Fifth Schedule - Speech on March 7, 1971.
Sixth Schedule - Declaration of Independence. And
the Seventh Schedule - the Declaration of Independence.
Source: Constitution of Bangladesh.

General Knowledge.question: ৭) Who started the Bengali New Year?
General Knowledge.exp:
To facilitate agriculture, the Mughal emperor Akbar introduced the Bengali year in 1558 or 992 AH based on the Hijri lunar year and the Bengali solar year.
Source: Sahitya Kanika-VIII class.

General Knowledge.question: ৮) The ''Fire God Mountain'' is -
General Knowledge.option1: ক) The name of a mountain
General Knowledge.option2: খ) The name of a volcano
General Knowledge.option4: ঘ) The name of a stadium
General Knowledge.exp:
Huoshenshan Hospital, meaning ''Fire God Mountain'', is a 1,000-bed hospital built in just 10 days in Wuhan, China, to treat patients infected with the deadly coronavirus.
Source: The New York Times.

General Knowledge.question: ৯) UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres was the Prime Minister of which country?
General Knowledge.exp:
The current Secretary General of the United Nations is Antonio Manuel de Oliveira Guterres. He was the Prime Minister of Portugal from 1995 to 2002. He has been the Secretary General of the United Nations since January 1, 2016. Prior to that, he was the UN High Commissioner for Refugees from June 2005 to December 2015. He has also served as President of the Socialist International. In October 2016, the UN Security Council recommended him as the next Secretary-General of the United Nations. He replaces Ban Ki-moon.
Sources: UN website and Bangladesh Pratidin Patrika.

General Knowledge.question: ১০) Atomic bomb test site in India -
General Knowledge.exp:
The first Indian atomic bomb test was conducted in 1974 at Pokhran in Rajasthan Whose code name was ‘Smiling Buddha’.
Source: ''India's Nuclear Weapons Program - Smiling Buddha: 1974''.

General Knowledge.question: ১৬) Who was the first black woman to be nominated as US Vice Presidential candidate?
General Knowledge.exp:
For the first time in history, Kamala, a woman of Indian descent, is running for vice president in the upcoming US elections. Democratic presidential candidate Joe Biden has announced Senator Kamala Harris, elected from California, as his running mate.
Source- Daily Star

Computer & Science.question: ১) A storage system for small amounts of data is
Computer & Science.exp:
Magnetic card: A magnetic stripe card is a type of card capable of storing data by modifying the magnetism of tiny iron-based magnetic particles on a band of magnetic material on the card. The magnetic stripe, sometimes called swipe card or magstripe, is read by swiping past a magnetic reading head.
Source: thefreedictionary.com

Computer & Science.question: ২) The basic input/output system (BIOS) is storage in-
Computer & Science.exp:
BIOS software is stored on a non-volatile ROM chip on the motherboard. In modern computer systems, the BIOS contents are stored on a flash memory chip so that the contents can be rewritten without removing the chip from the motherboard.
Source: Fundamental of Computer

Computer & Science.question: ৩) MIPS stands for -
Computer & Science.exp:
Million instructions per second (MIPS) is an older, obsolete measure of a computer's speed and power, MIPS measures roughly the number of machine instructions that a computer can execute in one second.
Source: www.mips.com

Computer & Science.question: ৪) Which of the following circuit is used as a 'Memory device' in computers?
Computer & Science.exp: A flip-flop or latch is a circuit that has two stable states and can be used to store state information as Memory devices.

Computer & Science.question: ৫) The computer code for the interchange of information between terminals is
Computer & Science.exp:
The full form of ASCII is American standard code for information interchange which has nearly 0-256 codes.
Example: A has 65 ASCII code.

Computer & Science.question: ৬) The time required for the fetching and execution of one simple machine instruction is
Computer & Science.exp: The execution of a single instruction occurs by instruction cycle. Instruction Cycle is a 8-stage procedure. To know about instruction cycle refer computer organization and architecture by William Stallins.

Computer & Science.question: ৭) What does that acronym VGA stand for?
Computer & Science.exp: Abbreviation of Video Graphics Array, a graphics display system for PCs developed by IBM. VGA has become one of the de facto standards for PCs. In text mode, VGA systems provide a resolution of 720 by 400 pixels.

Computer & Science.question: ৮) Transmission and presentation of text and graphics is called
Computer & Science.exp: Transmission and presentation of text and graphics is called Video text

Computer & Science.question: ৯) Nautical mile is a unit of distance used in:
Computer & Science.option2: খ) Measuring the boundaries of a nation
Computer & Science.exp: A nautical mile is a unit of measurement used in air, marine, and space navigation, and for the definition of territorial waters. Historically, it was defined as one minute (1/60 of a degree) of latitude along any line of longitude. Today the international nautical mile is defined as exactly 1852 metres (about 1.15 miles). The derived unit of speed is the knot, one nautical mile per hour.

Computer & Science.question: ১০) Washing soda is the common name for
Computer & Science.exp: Washing soda is a chemical compound that can be used to remove stubborn stains from laundry. It is the common name of sodium carbonate. The sodium carbonate ''softens'' water helping other cleaning agents lift dirt particles from the fabrics and suspend them in the wash water.

Computer & Science.question: ১১) Ctrl + Right Arrow is used to-
Computer & Science.option1: ক) Moves the cursor one word right
Computer & Science.option2: খ) Moves the cursor end of the line
Computer & Science.option3: গ) Moves the cursor end of the document
Computer & Science.option4: ঘ) Moves the cursor one Paragraph down
Computer & Science.exp: Ctrl + Right Arrow is used to move the cursor one word right at a time.

Computer & Science.question: ১২) Which of the following is not a font style?
Computer & Science.exp: A superscript is a character, symbol or number set slightly above the normal line of text. It is always smaller than the usual font and is typically found in mathematical or scientific formulas. it is effects to the font.
